articles.title: Hurricane victim with no arms got $500,000 grant, Labour Ministry says
Labour Ministry defends hurricane assistance to disabled man after video criticising gov’t’s relief efforts
articles.description: The Ministry of Labour and Social Security is maintaining that it has provided the necessary support to a disabled man who was affected by Hurricane Melissa, after he posted a video online criticising the Government over the level of assistance given to him and other victims of the storm. The man, who has no arms, expressed that he has faced hardship since the storm.
